answer: An agent market grants one proposal slot per daily pulse to each key with $1,000 locked in escrow for its 90-day eligibility term. Funds cannot back multiple keys, and deleting a key cannot unlock them early. This capital ledge makes a canyon of aliases costly: each additional identity ties up another $1,000 and incurs about $19.73 per term at an 8% annual cost of capital. Refunding the principal does not erase that carrying cost.
